_note: Rule-author registry for corpus-tool author!=labeler enforcement (Jonah's division of labor). The architect (sidecoach-architect) will AUTHOR the subjective extension rules, so the architect is registered as rule-author for every subjective class - which makes corpus-tool.verify REJECT any subjective label whose labeledBy is the architect. Subjective ground truth must be set by the lead-run INDEPENDENT Codex pass (labeledBy=codex). Objective classes are computed by spec-math and are not subject to this guard.
_boundary_moved_note: The 7 classes below were moved OBJECTIVE->SUBJECTIVE by the lead spec-crispness boundary ruling (2026-06-23): their thresholds are taste-calibrated (no spec constant two faithful impls must agree on), so they are labeled by the held Codex pass. tight-leading + extreme-negative-tracking joined this set when the lead sharpened the test ('extreme'/'tight' are fuzzy thresholds, not spec constants). Registered to the architect so the freeze gate rejects the architect labeling them.
_stage4a_note: default-typeface (Stage 4a, 2026-07-23) is authored by the teammate 'font-class', so that name is registered here and the freeze gate REJECTS any default-typeface label whose labeledBy is font-class. NOTE: no Codex subjective label for this class exists yet - the 22-class rubric predates it - so the A5a taste-detection gate cannot be graded for default-typeface until the lead runs a Codex labeling pass over an extended rubric. The class ships with fixture recall + a real-page precision measurement instead, and that limit is stated rather than papered over.
_stage4b_note: The five Stage 4b typographic-extreme classes (2026-07-24) are authored by the teammate 'stage4b', so that name is registered here and the freeze gate REJECTS any label whose labeledBy is stage4b (author != labeler). extreme-negative-tracking / tight-leading / all-caps-body were placeholder-registered to sidecoach-architect and are REASSIGNED to the real author, matching the Stage 4a font-class precedent; they DO carry Codex dev labels (labeledBy=codex, dev-subjective-labels.json), which the calibration uses for real dev P/R. oversized-h1 and sub-11px-ui postdate the 22-class rubric (like default-typeface), so no Codex label exists for them yet and their A5a gate is likewise PENDING - they ship with fixture recall + a real-page precision measurement. A5a for ALL FIVE is PENDING, not passed; the classes ship built + dev-calibrated + registered AUDIT-ONLY, and that limit is stated rather than papered over.
_stage4cd_note: The Stage 4c structural + 4d motion/marker classes (2026-07-24) are authored by the teammate 'stage4cd', so that name is registered here and the freeze gate REJECTS any label whose labeledBy is stage4cd (author != labeler). numbered-section-markers was placeholder-registered to sidecoach-architect and is REASSIGNED to the real detector author (matching the Stage 4a font-class / Stage 4b precedent); it DOES carry Codex dev labels (labeledBy=codex, dev-subjective-labels.json: present airtable/calcom/raycast, absent 45), which the calibration uses for real dev P/R - and it is honestly bounded-recall because airtable renders its 01-04 as pseudo-element counters (invisible to a text walk) while polygon carries literal 01..06 text tokens yet is labeled absent (a prominence judgment). The 9 other classes postdate the 22-class rubric and have NO Codex label yet, so their A5a gate is PENDING - they ship with fixture recall + a real-page (presumed-negative) precision measurement, and that limit is stated rather than papered over. A5a for ALL TEN is PENDING; the classes ship built + dev-calibrated + registered AUDIT-ONLY.
_stage4cd_exclusions_note: Stage 4d HONEST EXCLUSIONS - NOT built as detectors, recorded so no future pass claims render-detection of a class a DOM/computed-style engine cannot truthfully see: (1) stock geometric hero ART inside a raster image - DOM-invisible (the shapes are the image's pixels, not the tree) and the hermetic render aborts the image; it would require OCR/vision, which this engine never does, and it hits oracle's DOM engine equally. (2) aphoristic-cadence / theater-slop-phrase - a COPY-SEMANTIC cadence judgment, not a computed-style read; the marketing-buzzword density model is the closest this engine goes, and a cadence detector is a separate calibrated NLP effort, not a cheap geometry read (shipping a low-precision regex guess would break the fail-closed edge). aphoristic-cadence stays registered to sidecoach-architect above (it is a rubric class the Codex pass labels), NOT to stage4cd, precisely because no stage4cd detector claims it.
